<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Jake Ferreri — Mechanical Engineering Portfolio</title>
<meta name="description" content="Mechanical engineering portfolio of Jake Ferreri, junior at Brown University. Projects in aerodynamics, mechanical design, medical devices, and rocketry.">

<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Archivo:wght@500;600;800;900&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;600&family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

<style>
  :root{
    --paper:#F4F4F0;        /* drafting sheet */
    --paper-2:#FBFBF8;      /* raised surfaces */
    --ink:#15171B;          /* drafting ink */
    --graphite:#565B62;     /* secondary text */
    --line:#D0D0C9;         /* hairlines / grid */
    --line-soft:#E3E3DC;
    --accent:#1D4E89;       /* engineering blue — dimension/measure */
    --ochre:#A66A16;        /* in-progress status */
    --grid: rgba(21,23,27,0.045);
    --grid-strong: rgba(21,23,27,0.075);

    --display:'Archivo', sans-serif;
    --body:'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif;
    --mono:'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;

    --maxw:1180px;
    --pad:clamp(20px,5vw,64px);
  }

  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){ html{scroll-behavior:auto;} }

  body{
    margin:0;
    background-color:var(--paper);
    background-image:
      linear-gradient(var(--grid) 1px, transparent 1px),
      linear-gradient(90deg, var(--grid) 1px, transparent 1px),
      linear-gradient(var(--grid-strong) 1px, transparent 1px),
      linear-gradient(90deg, var(--grid-strong) 1px, transparent 1px);
    background-size:
      24px 24px, 24px 24px,
      120px 120px, 120px 120px;
    color:var(--ink);
    font-family:var(--body);
    font-size:16px;
    line-height:1.55;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  }

  a{color:inherit;}

  .wrap{max-width:var(--maxw);margin:0 auto;padding-left:var(--pad);padding-right:var(--pad);}

  /* ---------- mono utility label ---------- */
  .tag{
    font-family:var(--mono);
    font-size:11px;
    letter-spacing:.18em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--graphite);
  }

  /* ---------- HERO / TITLE BLOCK ---------- */
  header.hero{
    border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--ink);
    position:relative;
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  .hero__inner{
    padding-top:clamp(48px,9vw,110px);
    padding-bottom:clamp(28px,4vw,44px);
  }
  .hero__eyebrow{
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;
    margin-bottom:clamp(26px,5vw,54px);
  }
  .hero__eyebrow .rule{height:1px;background:var(--line);flex:1;}

  .hero__name{
    font-family:var(--display);
    font-weight:900;
    font-size:clamp(52px,13.5vw,168px);
    line-height:.92;
    letter-spacing:-.02em;
    margin:0;
    text-transform:uppercase;
  }
  .hero__name .u{color:var(--accent);}
  .hero__sub{
    font-family:var(--display);
    font-weight:600;
    font-size:clamp(15px,2.4vw,24px);
    letter-spacing:.01em;
    margin:clamp(14px,2vw,20px) 0 0;
    color:var(--ink);
    max-width:46ch;
  }

  /* title block grid */
  .titleblock{
    margin-top:clamp(34px,6vw,60px);
    border:1.5px solid var(--ink);
    background:var(--paper-2);
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
  }
  .tb__cell{
    padding:14px 16px 15px;
    border-right:1px solid var(--line);
    border-top:1px solid var(--line);
    min-width:0;
  }
  .tb__cell:nth-child(4n){border-right:none;}
  .tb__cell:nth-child(-n+4){border-top:none;}
  .tb__k{
    font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.16em;
    text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--graphite);display:block;margin-bottom:5px;
  }
  .tb__v{
    font-family:var(--body);font-weight:600;font-size:15px;line-height:1.35;
    word-break:break-word;overflow-wrap:anywhere;
  }
  .tb__v a{text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding-bottom:1px;}
  .tb__v a:hover{border-bottom-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent);}
  @media(max-width:900px){
    .titleblock{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}
    .tb__cell{border-right:1px solid var(--line);border-top:1px solid var(--line);}
    .tb__cell:nth-child(2n){border-right:none;}
    .tb__cell:nth-child(-n+2){border-top:none;}
  }

  /* ---------- DRAWING INDEX ---------- */
  section.index{padding-top:clamp(46px,7vw,88px);padding-bottom:clamp(20px,4vw,40px);}
  .index__head{
    display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;
    margin-bottom:22px;flex-wrap:wrap;
  }
  .index__head h2{
    font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;
    font-size:clamp(18px,2.6vw,26px);letter-spacing:.04em;margin:0;
  }
  .idx__row{
    display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:12px;text-decoration:none;
    padding:11px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line-soft);
    transition:padding-left .18s ease, background .18s ease;
  }
  .idx__row:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-soft);}
  .idx__row:hover{padding-left:10px;}
  .idx__no{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13px;color:var(--accent);font-weight:600;width:34px;flex:none;}
  .idx__title{
    font-family:var(--body);font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(15px,2vw,18px);
    white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;
  }
  .idx__dots{flex:1;border-bottom:1px dotted var(--line);transform:translateY(-4px);min-width:20px;}
  .idx__status{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;flex:none;color:var(--graphite);}
  .idx__status.is-done{color:var(--accent);}
  .idx__status.is-wip{color:var(--ochre);}

  /* ---------- SHEETS ---------- */
  main{padding-bottom:40px;}
  .sheet{padding-top:clamp(44px,7vw,86px);scroll-margin-top:20px;}

  .sheet__bar{
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;margin-bottom:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;
  }
  .sheet__no{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--graphite);}
  .status{
    font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:4px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius:2px;background:var(--paper-2);
  }
  .status::before{content:"";width:7px;height:7px;display:inline-block;border-radius:1px;}
  .status.is-done{color:var(--accent);border-color:rgba(29,78,137,.35);}
  .status.is-done::before{background:var(--accent);}
  .status.is-wip{color:var(--ochre);border-color:rgba(166,106,22,.4);}
  .status.is-wip::before{border:1.5px solid var(--ochre);background:transparent;width:6px;height:6px;}

  .sheet__title{
    font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;
    font-size:clamp(23px,4vw,42px);line-height:1.02;letter-spacing:-.01em;
    margin:0 0 clamp(22px,3vw,30px);max-width:22ch;
  }

  /* image plates */
  .plates{
    display:grid;gap:14px;margin-bottom:clamp(26px,3vw,34px);
    grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
  }
  .plates.one{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,560px);}
  .plates.two{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}
  .plates.four{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}
  .plates.five{grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);}
  .plates.five>*:nth-child(-n+2){grid-column:span 3;}
  .plates.five>*:nth-child(n+3){grid-column:span 2;}
  @media(max-width:760px){
    .plates{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;} .plates.one{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .plates.five{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;} .plates.five>*{grid-column:auto !important;}
  }
  @media(max-width:460px){ .plates, .plates.one, .plates.two, .plates.four, .plates.five{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }

  .plate{
    position:relative;aspect-ratio:4/3;margin:0;
    border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--paper-2);overflow:hidden;
  }
  .plate img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;}
  .plate__ph{
    position:absolute;inset:0;display:none;flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;padding:14px;text-align:center;
  }
  /* registration corner ticks on empty plates */
  .plate__ph::before,.plate__ph::after{
    content:"";position:absolute;width:14px;height:14px;border:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .plate__ph::before{top:8px;left:8px;border-right:none;border-bottom:none;}
  .plate__ph::after{bottom:8px;right:8px;border-left:none;border-top:none;}
  .plate__ph .g{
    width:26px;height:26px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:50%;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--graphite);
  }
  .plate__ph .g::after{content:"";position:absolute;width:38px;height:1px;background:var(--line);}
  .plate__lbl{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--graphite);}
  .plate__file{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;color:var(--accent);opacity:.85;}

  /* annotation columns */
  .cols{
    display:grid;gap:clamp(20px,3vw,40px);
    grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
    border-top:1.5px solid var(--ink);padding-top:24px;
  }
  @media(max-width:760px){ .cols{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:26px;} }
  .col__h{
    font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--ink);margin:0 0 14px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  }
  .col__h span{color:var(--accent);}
  .col ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;}
  .col li{
    position:relative;padding-left:20px;margin-bottom:13px;font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.5;color:#222;
  }
  .col li::before{
    content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:9px;width:8px;height:1px;background:var(--accent);
  }
  .col li b{font-weight:600;}
  .todo{
    display:inline-block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;color:var(--ochre);
    background:rgba(166,106,22,.08);border:1px dashed rgba(166,106,22,.5);
    padding:2px 7px;border-radius:2px;
  }
  .col .pending{
    font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13px;color:var(--graphite);line-height:1.6;
  }

  /* dimension-line divider */
  .dim{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin:clamp(46px,7vw,80px) 0 0;color:var(--line);}
  .dim__line{flex:1;height:1px;background:var(--line);position:relative;}
  .dim__line::before,.dim__line::after{
    content:"";position:absolute;top:50%;width:8px;height:8px;
    border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-right:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .dim__line::before{left:0;transform:translateY(-50%) rotate(-135deg);}
  .dim__line::after{right:0;transform:translateY(-50%) rotate(45deg);}
  .dim__txt{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--graphite);white-space:nowrap;}

  /* ---------- FOOTER ---------- */
  footer{
    margin-top:clamp(56px,8vw,96px);border-top:1.5px solid var(--ink);
    padding-top:clamp(34px,5vw,52px);padding-bottom:clamp(40px,6vw,70px);
  }
  .foot__grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr;gap:32px;align-items:end;}
  @media(max-width:720px){ .foot__grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:26px;} }
  .foot__name{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:900;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:clamp(30px,7vw,64px);line-height:.95;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:0 0 10px;}
  .foot__contact{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;}
  .foot__contact a{
    font-family:var(--mono);font-size:14px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--ink);
    display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;width:fit-content;
  }
  .foot__contact a .k{color:var(--graphite);letter-spacing:.14em;font-size:10.5px;text-transform:uppercase;}
  .foot__contact a:hover .v{color:var(--accent);border-bottom:1px solid var(--accent);}
  .foot__contact a .v{border-bottom:1px solid transparent;padding-bottom:1px;}
  .foot__meta{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;color:var(--graphite);letter-spacing:.1em;margin-top:26px;}

  /* reveal */
  .reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px);transition:opacity .6s ease, transform .6s ease;}
  .reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none;}
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){ .reveal{opacity:1;transform:none;transition:none;} }

  :focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px;}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- ============ HERO / TITLE BLOCK ============ -->
<header class="hero">
  <div class="wrap hero__inner">
   
    <h1 class="hero__name">Jake<br>Ferreri</h1>
    <p class="hero__sub">Junior Mechanical Engineering student at Brown University with design experience and ownership in FSAE mechanisms, medical devices, custom actuators, and composite aerospace components.</p>

    <div class="titleblock" aria-label="Contact and portfolio details">
      <div class="tb__cell">
        <span class="tb__k">Name</span>
        <span class="tb__v">Jake Ferreri</span>
      </div>
      <div class="tb__cell">
        <span class="tb__k">Discipline</span>
        <span class="tb__v">Mechanical Engineering</span>
      </div>
      <div class="tb__cell">
        <span class="tb__k">Institution</span>
        <span class="tb__v">Brown University</span>
      </div>
      <div class="tb__cell">
        <span class="tb__k">Status</span>
        <span class="tb__v">Junior · Class of 2028</span>
      </div>

      <div class="tb__cell">
        <span class="tb__k">Email</span>
        <span class="tb__v"><a href="mailto:jake_ferreri@brown.edu">jake_ferreri@brown.edu</a></span>
      </div>
      <div class="tb__cell">
        <span class="tb__k">LinkedIn</span>
        <span class="tb__v"><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/jake-ferreri/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">/in/jake-ferreri</a></span>
      </div>
      <div class="tb__cell">
        <span class="tb__k">Phone</span>
        <span class="tb__v"><a href="tel:+16468308801">646-830-8801</a></span>
      </div>
      <div class="tb__cell">
        <span class="tb__k">Sheets</span>
        <span class="tb__v">07 Projects</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</header>

<!-- ============ DRAWING INDEX ============ -->
<section class="index">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="index__head reveal">
      <h2>Projects</h2>
      <span class="tag">07 sheets · click to open</span>
    </div>

    <a class="idx__row reveal" href="#s01">
      <span class="idx__no">01</span>
      <span class="idx__title">Drag Reduction System — Brown Formula Racing</span>
      <span class="idx__dots"></span>
    </a>
    <a class="idx__row reveal" href="#s02">
      <span class="idx__no">02</span>
      <span class="idx__title">Pinch Valve Prototype — DesignXHealth</span>
      <span class="idx__dots"></span>
    </a>
    <a class="idx__row reveal" href="#s03">
      <span class="idx__no">03</span>
      <span class="idx__title">Potentiometer-Controlled Linear Actuator</span>
      <span class="idx__dots"></span>
    </a>
    <a class="idx__row reveal" href="#s04">
      <span class="idx__no">04</span>
      <span class="idx__title">6-Speed Constant-Mesh Gearbox</span>
      <span class="idx__dots"></span>
    </a>
    <a class="idx__row reveal" href="#s05">
      <span class="idx__no">05</span>
      <span class="idx__title">Multi-Element Aerodynamic Wing for RC Car</span>
      <span class="idx__dots"></span>
    </a>
    <a class="idx__row reveal" href="#s06">
      <span class="idx__no">06</span>
      <span class="idx__title">Temperature Monitoring Device — BU EK 131</span>
      <span class="idx__dots"></span>
    </a>
    <a class="idx__row reveal" href="#s07">
      <span class="idx__no">07</span>
      <span class="idx__title">Mach 3+ Fiberglass Rocket Nose Cone</span>
      <span class="idx__dots"></span>
    </a>
  </div>
</section>

<main>

  <!-- ===== SHEET 01 — DRS ===== -->
  <section class="sheet" id="s01">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="sheet__bar reveal">
        <span class="sheet__no">Sheet 01 / 07</span>
        <span class="tag">Brown Formula Racing · FSAE</span>
      </div>
      <h3 class="sheet__title reveal">Drag Reduction System for FSAE Car</h3>

      <div class="plates five reveal">
        <figure class="plate">
          <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="DRS mechanism in the high-downforce (closed) configuration" onerror="this.style.display='none';this.nextElementSibling.style.display='flex';">
          <div class="plate__ph"><span class="g"></span><span class="plate__lbl">Awaiting plate</span><span class="plate__file">images/drs-closed.jpg</span></div>
        </figure>
        <figure class="plate">
          <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="DRS mechanism in the low-drag (open) configuration" onerror="this.style.display='none';this.nextElementSibling.style.display='flex';">
          <div class="plate__ph"><span class="g"></span><span class="plate__lbl">Awaiting plate</span><span class="plate__file">images/drs-open.jpg</span></div>
        </figure>
        <figure class="plate">
          <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Close-up of the pushrod, rod-end, and clevis-bracket pivot" onerror="this.style.display='none';this.nextElementSibling.style.display='flex';">
          <div class="plate__ph"><span class="g"></span><span class="plate__lbl">Awaiting plate</span><span class="plate__file">images/drs-zoom.jpg</span></div>
        </figure>
        <figure class="plate">
          <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="STAR-CCM+ CFD pressure distribution across the wing" onerror="this.style.display='none';this.nextElementSibling.style.display='flex';">
          <div class="plate__ph"><span class="g"></span><span class="plate__lbl">Awaiting plate</span><span class="plate__file">images/drs-cfd.jpg</span></div>
        </figure>
        <figure class="plate">
          <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Bench test rig for validating the pneumatic actuator stroke" onerror="this.style.display='none';this.nextElementSibling.style.display='flex';">
          <div class="plate__ph"><span class="g"></span><span class="plate__lbl">Awaiting plate</span><span class="plate__file">images/drs-testrig.jpg</span></div>
        </figure>
      </div>

      <div class="cols reveal">
        <div class="col">
          <p class="col__h"><span>A</span> What</p>
          <ul>
            <li>Rear-wing drag reduction system (DRS) for the 2027 FSAE car.</li>
            <li>Decreases airfoil angles of attack into a low-downforce configuration, cutting drag on straights and increasing aerodynamic efficiency.</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
        <div class="col">
          <p class="col__h"><span>B</span> How</p>
          <ul>
            <li>A double-acting pneumatic cylinder drives a system of mechanical linkages, rotating three airfoils from the default high-downforce setting to near-zero angles of attack.</li>
            <li>Uses the car's existing air tank for actuation — adding performance for minimal added weight and complexity.</li>
            <li>Waterjet-cut carbon fiber linkages and SLS-printed Nylon 12 clevis brackets for lightweight strength.</li>
            <li>Shoulder bolts and bronze bushings for low-friction pinned joints at the clevises.</li>
            <li>An extension spring, airfoil centers of pressure ahead of the pivots, and a solenoid return spring default the mechanism to the closed position in the event of pneumatic or electrical failure.</li>
            <li>Hand calculations and FEA validate stresses in the clevis brackets.</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
        <div class="col">
          <p class="col__h"><span>C</span> Progress</p>
          <ul>
            <li>Design finalized.</li>
	    <li>Extracted aero loads at peak loading condition (top speed at end of straight w/ DRS open) using Siemens STAR-CCM+.</li>
            <li>Clevis-bracket stresses validated with hand calcs and FEA in Ansys Mechanical using extracted aero loads from CFD.</li>
            <li>Designed a test rig utilizing the team's jig table to test actuator stroke before installing full mechanism on car.</li>
            <li>Carbon fiber and SLS Nylon 12 clevis brackets will be manufactured upon return to school in September.</li>
            <li>Targeting full rear-wing implementation by the end of December, before winter break.</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <div class="wrap"><div class="dim"><span class="dim__line"></span><span class="dim__txt">Sheet 01 — 02</span><span class="dim__line"></span></div></div>

  <!-- ===== SHEET 02 — PINCH VALVE ===== -->
  <section class="sheet" id="s02">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="sheet__bar reveal">
        <span class="sheet__no">Sheet 02 / 07</span>
        <span class="tag">Brown University · DesignXHealth</span>
      </div>
      <h3 class="sheet__title reveal">Pinch Valve Prototype</h3>

      <div class="plates four reveal">
        <figure class="plate">
          <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Pinch valve CAD, closed" onerror="this.style.display='none';this.nextElementSibling.style.display='flex';">
          <div class="plate__ph"><span class="g"></span><span class="plate__lbl">Awaiting plate</span><span class="plate__file">images/valve-1.jpg</span></div>
        </figure>
        <figure class="plate">
          <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Pinch valve CAD, section" onerror="this.style.display='none';this.nextElementSibling.style.display='flex';">
          <div class="plate__ph"><span class="g"></span><span class="plate__lbl">Awaiting plate</span><span class="plate__file">images/valve-2.jpg</span></div>
        </figure>
        <figure class="plate">
          <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Pinch valve build 1" onerror="this.style.display='none';this.nextElementSibling.style.display='flex';">
          <div class="plate__ph"><span class="g"></span><span class="plate__lbl">Awaiting plate</span><span class="plate__file">images/valve-3.jpg</span></div>
        </figure>
        <figure class="plate">
          <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Pinch valve build 2" onerror="this.style.display='none';this.nextElementSibling.style.display='flex';">
          <div class="plate__ph"><span class="g"></span><span class="plate__lbl">Awaiting plate</span><span class="plate__file">images/valve-4.jpg</span></div>
        </figure>
      </div>

      <div class="cols reveal">
        <div class="col">
          <p class="col__h"><span>A</span> What</p>
          <ul>
            <li>A motorized pinch-valve mechanism that regulates dialysate inflow and outflow to the patient — built as a prototype for a pediatric dialysis machine.</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
        <div class="col">
          <p class="col__h"><span>B</span> How</p>
          <ul>
            <li>A stepper motor and lead screw convert rotational motion into smooth, precise linear motion.</li>
            <li>The linear actuator drives a clamp to specific positions, achieving precise fluid flow rates by varying how much a tube is pinched.</li>
            <li>A removable lid and base plate let the motor be taken out for maintenance or replacement.</li>
            <li>A machined acetal lead-screw nut and linear ball bearing achieve zero clamp wobble.</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
        <div class="col">
          <p class="col__h"><span>C</span> Progress</p>
          <ul>
            <li>Full prototype designed, 3D-printed, and assembled.</li>
            <li>Acetal lead-screw nut and linear ball bearing achieve zero clamp wobble.</li>
            <li>Currently breadboard testing the stepper motor to test repeatability of clamp positions.</li>
            <li>Initial bench runs showed stepper stutter on A4988 drivers. Testing with TMC2209s instead for more reliable motion w/ UART current limiting.</li>
            <li>Next: test tubing with fluid to pair target positions with specific flow rates.</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <div class="wrap"><div class="dim"><span class="dim__line"></span><span class="dim__txt">Sheet 02 — 03</span><span class="dim__line"></span></div></div>

  <!-- ===== SHEET 03 — LINEAR ACTUATOR ===== -->
  <section class="sheet" id="s03">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="sheet__bar reveal">
        <span class="sheet__no">Sheet 03 / 07</span>
      </div>
      <h3 class="sheet__title reveal">Potentiometer-Controlled Electric Linear Actuator with Gear Reduction &amp; Position Feedback</h3>

      <div class="plates five reveal">
        <figure class="plate">
          <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Linear actuator CAD, exterior" onerror="this.style.display='none';this.nextElementSibling.style.display='flex';">
          <div class="plate__ph"><span class="g"></span><span class="plate__lbl">Awaiting plate</span><span class="plate__file">images/actuator-1.jpg</span></div>
        </figure>
        <figure class="plate">
          <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Assembled linear actuator with stepper motor and gear coupling" onerror="this.style.display='none';this.nextElementSibling.style.display='flex';">
          <div class="plate__ph"><span class="g"></span><span class="plate__lbl">Awaiting plate</span><span class="plate__file">images/actuator-build-1.jpg</span></div>
        </figure>
        <figure class="plate">
          <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Linear actuator CAD, section" onerror="this.style.display='none';this.nextElementSibling.style.display='flex';">
          <div class="plate__ph"><span class="g"></span><span class="plate__lbl">Awaiting plate</span><span class="plate__file">images/actuator-2.jpg</span></div>
        </figure>
        <figure class="plate">
          <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Close-up of the assembled linear actuator drive" onerror="this.style.display='none';this.nextElementSibling.style.display='flex';">
          <div class="plate__ph"><span class="g"></span><span class="plate__lbl">Awaiting plate</span><span class="plate__file">images/actuator-build-2.jpg</span></div>
        </figure>
        <figure class="plate">
          <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Test rig running: actuator, Arduino, and LCD showing live position and speed" onerror="this.style.display='none';this.nextElementSibling.style.display='flex';">
          <div class="plate__ph"><span class="g"></span><span class="plate__lbl">Awaiting plate</span><span class="plate__file">images/actuator-test.jpg</span></div>
        </figure>
      </div>

      <div class="cols reveal">
        <div class="col">
          <p class="col__h"><span>A</span> What</p>
          <ul>
            <li>Stepper motor-powered linear actuator with potentiometer control, and displays live actuator extension on an LCD screen.</li>
            <li>Gear reduction doubles the torque applied to the actuator stroke.</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
        <div class="col">
          <p class="col__h"><span>B</span> How</p>
          <ul>
            <li>A NEMA 17 stepper motor turns an ACME lead screw fixed to an acetal lead-screw nut for low-friction, precise linear motion.</li>
            <li>A 20-tooth, 48 DP pinion on the motor shaft mates with a 40-tooth, 48 DP driven gear on the lead screw for a 2:1 gear reduction.</li>
            <li>An Arduino Uno and TMC2209 driver program the stepper's motion and current limiting.</li>
            <li>Two 10 kΩ potentiometers let the user manually control actuator position and speed.</li>
            <li>An LCD screen displays actuator position and speed.</li>
            <li>A ball bearing inside the tube assembly minimizes friction between the actuator and its housing.</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
        <div class="col">
          <p class="col__h"><span>C</span> Progress</p>
          <ul>
            <li>Parts manufactured, assembly fully constructed, and successfully achieved actuator linear travel with potentiometer speed control!</li>
            <li>Screen lists live actuator speed and displacement since device turned on.</li>
            <li>Next: fix stuttering at moderate to higher speeds >2,000 steps/sec for more consistent motion control.</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <div class="wrap"><div class="dim"><span class="dim__line"></span><span class="dim__txt">Sheet 03 — 04</span><span class="dim__line"></span></div></div>

        </figure>
        <figure class="plate">
          <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Gearbox physical build" onerror="this.style.display='none';this.nextElementSibling.style.display='flex';">
          <div class="plate__ph"><span class="g"></span><span class="plate__lbl">Awaiting plate</span><span class="plate__file">images/gearbox-3.jpg</span></div>
        </figure>
      </div>

      <div class="cols reveal">
        <div class="col">
          <p class="col__h"><span>A</span> What</p>
          <ul>
            <li>Custom 3D-printed 6-speed manual transmission.</li>
            <li>Levers and dog clutches engage the desired gear pairs to the output shaft.</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
        <div class="col">
          <p class="col__h"><span>B</span> How</p>
          <ul>
            <li>Researched spur-gear design principles to define mathematically driven gear profiles.</li>
            <li>Developed a parametric spur-gear model in SolidWorks.</li>
            <li>Global variables drive features such as number of teeth, diametral pitch, and face width.</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
        <div class="col">
          <p class="col__h"><span>C</span> Results</p>
          <ul>
            <li>Successfully manufactured and assembled — fully functional.</li>
            <li>Finite element analysis and topology optimization reduced gear mass by <b>60%</b> over the initial design.</li>
            <li>Resolved dog-clutch engagement and gear-movement issues by revising part designs.</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

        </figure>

      <div class="cols reveal">
        <div class="col">
          <p class="col__h"><span>A</span> What</p>
          <ul>
            <li>Multi-element wing that increases rear downforce on an RC car, improving handling performance.</li>
            <li>Detachable mounting bracket lets the wing fit other RC car models.</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
        <div class="col">
          <p class="col__h"><span>B</span> How</p>
          <ul>
            <li>Used XFOIL to modify NACA 9712 airfoil geometry, raising the lift coefficient for the Re = 50,000 flow regime relevant to the RC car.</li>
            <li>Used SolidWorks Flow Simulation to optimize element positions for maximum downforce.</li>
            <li>3D-printed the full assembly.</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
        <div class="col">
          <p class="col__h"><span>C</span> Results</p>
          <ul>
            <li>Modified NACA 9712 airfoil achieves <b>19.66%</b> higher lift coefficient and <b>11.14%</b> higher lift-to-drag ratio vs. the stock airfoil at a 12° angle of attack.</li>
            <li>Generates <b>1.9 N</b> of downforce at 40 mph.</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

          <ul>
            <li>Researched supersonic nose-cone aerodynamics and settled on a conical profile.</li>
            <li>Modeled a 6.5:1 conical nose cone and molds in Fusion 360.</li>
            <li>3D-printed the molds for a positive hand layup using fiberglass "sleeves."</li>
            <li>Machined an Aluminum 7075 tip with an eyebolt to house the recovery system and complete the cone geometry.</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
        <div class="col">
          <p class="col__h"><span>C</span> Results</p>
          <ul>
            <li>Nose cone sits flush with the main body tube — no clearance issues, a successful fit.</li>
            <li>Launched in the Mojave Desert; cleared the launch tower and held the intended trajectory through motor burnout, 4 seconds after ignition.</li>

<script>
  // Scroll reveal — respects reduced-motion (elements just show, no animation)
  (function(){
    var els = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
    if (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches){
      els.forEach(function(el){ el.classList.add('in'); });
      return;
    }
    if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window)){
      els.forEach(function(el){ el.classList.add('in'); });
      return;
    }
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
      entries.forEach(function(e){
        if (e.isIntersecting){ e.target.classList.add('in'); io.unobserve(e.target); }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });
    els.forEach(function(el){ io.observe(el); });
  })();
</script>
